name: OWASP Juice Shop (deliberately insecure web shop, Node.js/Express/Angular)
loc: app/ after prep (20.3.0): 465 files, 112.2k lines, of which bom.json 42.1k and ftp/package-lock.json.bak 21.3k; TypeScript 273 files / 23.5k lines outside tests (server side 10.6k in 117 files, Angular frontend 12.9k) plus 123 spec files / 19.1k lines
note: Roadmap R33. Not an advisory benchmark: the vulnerabilities are the game's challenges, and the key is generated by benchmark/real/juice-key.mjs from the release's coding-challenge markers (vuln-line comments). The npm package `juice-shop` was unpublished in 2019, so the source is the packaged release asset attached to the GitHub release (an uploaded file, byte-stable; GitHub lists its sha256 digest, which matches the pinned value). It is not a GitHub `archive/refs/tags` tarball. The asset bundles node_modules (with .bin symlinks), the compiled server (build/) and the compiled frontend (frontend/dist); those are never extracted (`exclude`). The fixes, solutions and challenge texts the release ships are removed from app/ (`withhold`), and the marker comments are blanked in place (`strip_markers`).
